name: terrace_farm
description: Parametric hillside terrace farm (梯田): levels climb toward +z with 1-block height steps, each terrace terrace_depth rows wide (2-4 incl. a back-row water channel), retaining wall + ridge cap (田埂: cobblestone_wall/dirt_path) at every step, a zigzag spill per wall pouring into the channel below (层间下灌), farmland rows with mature crops cycling per level, and solid earth fill down to origin y so nothing floats.
when_to_use: Farms on slopes, rice-terrace silhouettes, village agriculture belts. origin = min corner of the LOWEST terrace's surface, y = its field layer; the structure climbs toward +z (rotate your site plan, not the output). Place it against a hillside or let the built-in fill columns form the earthwork; pair with road_segment for an access path along the front.
use_for: 山坡农田/稻梯田轮廓/村庄农业带;levels 多=远山梯景,levels 少+宽=村口菜地

origin.notes: 最低层田面最小角;y = 田面层;向 +z 逐级抬升

levels.notes: 层数;每层 +1 高、占 terrace_depth+1 进深

terrace_depth.notes: 每层行数(含水渠行);灌溉半径 4,不许更宽

crops.notes: 每层循环一种;可加 minecraft:beetroots

wall_material.notes: 挡土墙;mossy_cobblestone 更野,stone_bricks 更规整,mud_bricks 稻田风

ridge.notes: 田埂压边:圆石墙/土径/无

fill_material.notes: 田体填土(每柱填到 origin 的 y)

spill.notes: 每道墙一个水口,左右 zigzag 交替

pitfalls: 整体只朝 +z 爬坡;要别朝向就在放的时候换算坐标,不要手改输出
水口格会替换该处的田埂,属于设计;spill=false 才是完整田埂
terrace_depth 锁死 2-4:MC 水只能润 4 格,做宽了既假又'干',想宽就加层
田体填土填到 origin 的 y;贴在真山坡上用 terraform_pad 先整出坡脚,别让填土柱露出悬崖
水渠在每层后排、贴挡土墙;作物行在前排——别把水渠行改种作物,那是层间下灌的魂
levels 多进深就大:总进深 = levels*(terrace_depth+1)-1,放之前算好别压到后排建筑
example: python patterns/terrace_farm.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"width":10,"levels":4,"crops":["minecraft:wheat","minecraft:carrots"]}' --out terrace.json && python patterns/terrace_farm.py --params '{"origin":[140,64,100],"width":14,"levels":6,"terrace_depth":2,"wall_material":"minecraft:mud_bricks","ridge":"dirt_path"}' --out rice.json
